<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.194, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.187 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely using only C, H, and O atoms is C₁₆H₂₇O₃ (calculated [M+H]⁺ = 268.203 Da, within typical instrument tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C16H27O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H27O3</final_answer>
